title: Falling Player Ragdoll
description: This mod adds a ragdoll animation to the player when falling. Still pretty buggy and it's the first version so expect it to be kind of problematic. Hope you enjoy!
body:
# Falling Player Ragdoll

Hi, welcome to my first mod. Planning to publish on Curseforge. Hope you enjoy.

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc09d82821234f6e9048e1f379edd22fd0493517.png)

This mod adds a custom ragdoll falling animation, inspired in Reanimated Blue [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reanimated-blue](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reanimated-blue). There are plans on adding more falling animations such as free falling, diving, and parachuting.

It is still on development and can and will cause bugs. Please report them at this discord server ([Falling Player Ragdoll Discord server](https://discord.gg/Vaz68Btp)).
